name: Bishop
caption: A scarred, hardcore-leaning face out of Chicago who won the BWA's own first Heavyweight Title Tournament the night the promotion debuted.
notes: Billed as a former wrestler under BWA's own President in his prior Independent Championship E-Wrestling promotion; also billed in this collection as a second, unreconciled claimant to the IEWF World Heavyweight Title (see iewf-lwc's own title record).

name: "Shotgun" Steve Lawless
caption: A Toronto brawler who lost his BWA Heavyweight Title Tournament opener to Ace Malone by a pinfall off a handful of tights.

name: "British Bad Boy" Miles Alexander
caption: A cocky London brawler who beat Tik Durpin on BWA's debut broadcast, signed too late to join the promotion's own first title tournament.

name: Tik Durpin
caption: A technically-edged wrestler who lost by pinfall to Miles Alexander on BWA's second Raw Footage broadcast.

name: "Snakeyes" Brian Fury
caption: A San Diego high flyer who lost to Nomad's technical mastery on BWA's second Raw Footage broadcast.

name: HAUS
caption: A decorated submission wrestler, billed on his BWA debut as a former World and Cruiserweight champion elsewhere, introduced on the wing's post-Carnage broadcast.
notes: Billed on arrival as a former NWF and GWFA World Tag Champion, RMWF Canadian Champion and GFWA Cruiserweight Champion; those tenures are outside this collection's own held record and are not separately registered.

name: Frank Addams
